ah_bar_phantom_bug_root_cause.location: tech_collector/backtest.py::_find_scan_bar_ts (selection layer); compounded by missing main-loop TIME-exit invariant in _simulate_trade
ah_bar_phantom_bug_root_cause.bug: When raw_bars for a (symbol, ET-date) contained ONLY same-day after-hours bars (regular-session bars missing), _find_scan_bar_ts returned the first AH bar's UTC ts because et.hour=19 satisfied any reasonable scan_time and et.date matched signal_date. _simulate_trade then anchored entry on that AH bar; first iteration of main loop fired timestop (et.hour=19 > 15), recording a phantom-TIME exit with bogus gross from AH-vs-research-scan-price gap.
ah_bar_phantom_bug_root_cause.downstream_effect: 14 phantom rows out of 2058 in the v0.7.11 (a) baseline. Concentrated on SMCI (×7), PLTR (×5), LITE, APP. Gross out of invariant band ([-876.6, +864.2] vs allowed [-157.5, +82.5]).
ah_bar_phantom_bug_root_cause.introduced: Existed in nascent form pre-v0.7.11 but was masked by the storage-layer UTC-date filter that dropped same-day AH bars. v0.7.11 correctly began including those bars, exposing the bar-selection vulnerability.
ah_bar_phantom_bug_root_cause.fix_summary: Two-part: (1) _find_scan_bar_ts requires matched bar's ET time to be in regular session (09:30-15:59). Returns None for AH-only or pre-market-only bar lists; run_backtest emits NO_DATA. (2) _simulate_trade's main-loop TIME exit applies the same [-sl_level, +tp_level] invariant the fallback path already had — defense-in-depth against any future regression at the bar-selection layer.

GET /source-version.description: Public, no auth. Returns SHA256 hash and file path for backtest, feature_computer, api, storage, backtest_audit. Compare to deployed_module_hashes_v0_7_12 to verify deploy.

GET /backtest/engine-selftest.description: Public, no auth. Runs three canonical scenarios (TP-then-moon, invariant-fires, DST-correctness) hitting _simulate_trade directly. Returns all_pass.
GET /backtest/engine-selftest.limitation: Does NOT cover storage layer or _find_scan_bar_ts AH-guard end-to-end. Don't trust as sole verification.

GET /raw-bars/coverage.description: Public, no auth. Query: ?symbol=X&date=YYYY-MM-DD. Returns bar-coverage breakdown for one (symbol, ET trading date) pair: {n_pre_market, n_regular_session, n_after_hours, first_bar_et, last_bar_et, phantom_risk}. phantom_risk=true when n_regular_session==0 and n_after_hours>0 — the exact failure mode v0.7.12 now correctly handles.
GET /raw-bars/coverage.intended_use_post_deploy: Confirm the missing-regular-session hypothesis on real production data: GET /raw-bars/coverage?symbol=SMCI&date=2024-11-14 should return phantom_risk=true. If it doesn't, the v0.7.12 hypothesis is wrong and we need to investigate further before re-running (a).
